globalDeclarations.name: original_normalized_upper_tail
globalDeclarations.head:
theorem original_normalized_upper_tail
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) {Ω : Type*} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [hμ : IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (g : Ω → ℝ) (hg : Measurable g) (hg2 : MemLp g 2 μ)
    (hgmean : (∫ o : Ω, g o ∂μ) = 0)
    (hgsecond : (∫ o : Ω, (g o) ^ (2 : ℕ) ∂μ) = 1)
    (y : ℝ) (hy : (1 : ℝ) ≤ y) :
    (Shao.OQ6.CanonicalDoubleGhostRowMoments.sampleLaw n μ).real
      {x : Fin n → Ω |
        Real.sqrt y * Real.rpow (n : ℝ) ((1 : ℝ) / 4) *
            ((4 : ℝ) + Real.sqrt
              (Shao.OQ6.OriginalGhostGoodEvent.sampleEnergy n g x / (n : ℝ))) <
          |Shao.OQ6.OriginalGhostGoodEvent.sampleSum n g x /
            Real.sqrt (n : ℝ)|} ≤
      (4 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(y * Real.sqrt (n : ℝ)) / (2 : ℝ))

localPropositionFacts.scope: local to the sole prospective theorem, after required aliases/facts

    dsimp only [q, r]
    calc
      (Real.rpow (n : ℝ) ((1 : ℝ) / 4)) ^ (2 : ℕ) =
          Real.rpow (n : ℝ) (((1 : ℝ) / 4) * (2 : ℝ)) :=
        (Real.rpow_mul_natCast hNnonneg ((1 : ℝ) / 4) 2).symm
      _ = Real.rpow (n : ℝ) ((1 : ℝ) / 2) := by norm_num
      _ = Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) := (Real.sqrt_eq_rpow (n : ℝ)).symm
localPropositionFacts.captureInterpretation: Complete frozen source-semantic capture contract. This is not a kernel-reported minimal free-variable set.
localPropositionFacts.justification: The symmetric direction of Real.rpow_mul_natCast at nonnegative base n, exponent 1/4 and natural exponent2 gives q^2=n^((1/4)*2). Rational normalization gives exponent1/2 and reversed sqrt_eq_rpow gives r. The outer square is natural Pow, not real rpow.

    (hgmean : (∫ o : Ω, g o ∂μ) = 0)
    (hgsecond : (∫ o : Ω, (g o) ^ (2 : ℕ) ∂μ) = 1)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : (1 : ℝ) ≤ t) :

            |Shao.OQ6.OriginalGhostGoodEvent.sampleSum n g x|} ≤
      (4 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(t ^ (2 : ℕ)) / (2 : ℝ))
